name: lotj-holocron-3d

author: Veska

scripts.check: pnpm renderer:typecheck && node --check poc/tools/mock-bridge.mjs && node --check poc/tools/network-bridge.mjs && node --check poc/tools/websocket-observer.mjs && node --check tools/electron-dev.mjs && node --check electron/main/bootstrap.mjs && node --check electron/main/main.mjs && node --check electron/shared/protocol.mjs && node --check electron/shared/relay-auth.mjs && node --check electron/shared/windows-paths.mjs && node --check electron/preload/preload.cjs && node --check forge.config.cjs

scripts.make: pnpm renderer:build && pnpm relay:build && pnpm mudlet:package && electron-forge make
